messages:
Nina: quick postmortem follow-up 1: we captured the recurring paging patterns and annotated root causes. sharing proposed action plan below. link: https://internal.redwood/postmortems/pmt-2026-03 :memo:
Omar: thanks. can you call out the measurable success criteria? want to avoid vague "reduce noise" asks.
Nina: good call. aim = 60% reduction in duplicate pages for top-5 rules and <5% false-suppression risk measured over 14d after rollout.
Priya: I'll own the dedupe work for the api-gateway alerts. rough plan: run canary suppression -> observe suppression_rate & missed_incidents -> if metrics look good, promote to global. ETA: canary results by Tue.
Omar: I'll take auth-timeout noise trimming. plan is to tighten 95th->99th latency thresholds with a sliding window and short cooldowns. also adding histogram-based gating so bursts don't immediately page.
Nina: for model inference OOM bursts we agreed to two-pronged approach: emergency mem-bump (infra ticket) + longer-term rate-limit and graceful reject policy. Priya/Omar let's flag any model owners that need to be notified.
Priya: canary suppression config I tested locally (pseudo-yaml):
```
- name: api-gateway-dedupe-v2
  group_by: path_prefix
  window: 4m
  max_pages: 1
  allow_urgent: true  # still page if error rate > 30%
```
Priya: the `allow_urgent` gate prevents hiding true failures. will run synthetic churn to validate.
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4892 "api-gateway dedupe canary" assigned to Priya, due 2026-04-06.
Omar: can we add an observability check: `missed_alert_estimate > 0.02 for 1h` triggers immediate rollback alert? we should avoid silent failures.
Nina: agreed. add two checks: suppression_rate and missed_alert_estimate. both must be visible on dashboard + slack webhook.
Priya: rollout plan: canary on staging -> canary on low-traffic region (asia-west) -> monitor 48h -> global. rollback criteria included in runbook.
Omar: paging policy tweak: critical: escalate within 5m if no ack; high: single page, then suppress duplicates for 20m. adding a notification for service-owner on suppression.
Nina: owners & deadlines recap: Priya (api dedupe canary) due Tue; Omar (auth thresholds + gating) due Fri; Nina (runbook + dashboards) due next Wed. weekly check-in: Thurs 11:00 30m.
Priya: I'll post canary logs & the diff of the suppression rule here when deployed. also exporting a short CSV of current top noisy rules for the board.
Nina: small process ask 1: let's log every suppression change in the postmortem action sheet with rationale and rollback steps. will make template.
ops-bot: Note: linked postmortem PMT-2026-03 to action INF-4892, INF-4893.
Omar: sounds good. if we hit >5% missed_alert_estimate during canary I'll pause and escalate to infra.
Priya: starting canary now, will update in ~1h with initial suppression_rate snapshot. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Nina: thanks team. ping @oncall if any pages spike during the rollout window. I'll update the action tracker and the dashboard links before EOD. :white_check_mark:
